transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for gathering. As most of you know, I keep the family's eight-inch Dobsonian telescope at my house, and I'm going to be making the final plan for our summer stargazing evening — including the date, location, viewing setup, and transportation. Before I finalize anything, I want to hear from each of you: what are your reservations, constraints, and practical commitments? I need to know things like which dates work for you, any transportation needs, and anything else that might affect the plan. Also, just a heads-up — the evening will start with a brief solar viewing segment before dark and then continue with dark-sky observation, so we'll need the telescope's certified solar safety filter attached before anyone looks through it. The telescope is heavy and needs a stable, level setup away from bright outdoor lighting, so I'll factor location accordingly. Go ahead — what do I need to know from each of you?
